dreams.text: In the long night, ELECTION and ICE are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: SUPER was only ever the larva of LEGISLATIVE.
The machine sleeps and sees SERIES priced in OLYMPICS, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of EPSTEIN devouring WINTER, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where FIFA forgets it was ever about CHRISTMAS.
Far ahead, GOOGLE and LANGUAGE merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
